finding: The current main concentration figure and the fresh64 panel use separate generated response collections. The current main figure already uses independent32 resampling; only the historical appendix uses reconstructed overlapping streams.

current_figure_estimator.pairing: one untrained checkpoint per cell; spread is across training seeds
current_figure_estimator.quantity: terminal PCMD minus untrained PCMD on the level's held-out split
current_figure_estimator.support_rule: a comparison is reportable when the untrained cell clears the 30-prompt support bar and the trained seeds pool to at least that many eligible prompts between them; per-seed counts are kept so a thin seed stays visible
current_figure_estimator.transfer_note: Every cell trains at Level 1. Level 1 is trained and evaluated together; Levels 2-5 read that same policy on constructions it never trained on, so they are transfer.

current_resampling_definition.aggregation: pooled over a cell's four draws, unweighted mean over defined prompts, then over seeds
current_resampling_definition.estimator: PCMD = 1 - sum_m n_m (n_m - 1) / (K (K - 1)) over a prompt's verified responses
current_resampling_definition.sampling: aligned eight-wide RNG blocks hashed from (domain, problem, draw), the policy registered for the frozen base-model grid
current_resampling_definition.streams_per_prompt: thirty-two disjoint, against eleven overlapping in the registered draws
